title: TechnologyFunction
description: TOGAF-sourced mechanism archetype — a behavioral unit providing technology processing, storage, or communication capability within a Technology Component. Analogous to ApplicationFunction (behavioral unit within Application Components). Extends Mechanism with TOGAF Technology Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: implicit in Content Metamodel (Technology Components deliver Technology Services through behavioral units). Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture, Content Framework).

functionCategory.description: Technology function capability category. TOGAF mapping: Technology Architecture capability classification.

automationLevel.description: Level of automation for this technology function. TOGAF mapping: Technology Architecture automation maturity.
